description: This PHP file defines the SubunitAPI class which provides RESTful API endpoints for managing organizational subunits within an HRM system. It includes methods for CRUD operations, validation rules, and integrates with services for handling subunit data, with OpenAPI documentation annotations.

classes.name: SubunitAPI
classes.description: Class providing API endpoints for managing organizational subunits (CRUD operations) in the HRM system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subunit by ID, returns subunit data or throws a not found exception.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all subunits, supports depth and mode filtering for tree or list views.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new subunit under a specified parent subunit.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing subunit identified by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a subunit by ID, returning the deleted subunit data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for retrieving a single subunit.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validation rules for listing subunits with optional filters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating a new subunit, including unique name constraints.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a subunit, ensuring unique name and valid ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for deleting a subunit, preventing deletion of root or top-level nodes.

methods.name: setParamsToSubunit
methods.description: Sets parameters from request to a Subunit entity instance.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Helper method to generate common validation rules for request body parameters.
